reviews.independent_scope: Vulkan resident waiter, public pool contract, controlled shutdown tests and new native-ready pipeline cases
checked: Only pool worker performs native wait; active Completion observations are exclusive under the pipeline monitor.
Response epoch is captured before observations; newly ready native work and other pending stages continue to advance.
Start refusal/queued cancellation precede runtime-prefix acceptance; running job services normal/error/cancel cleanup.
Root joins the CPU lane and active response, drains accepted handles, then waits for stop/destroy_done before leases.finish.
Admitted root reference survives the pool-job reference handoff; controlled gates and early-return cleanup preserve storage.
Second native branch and cap1 cases assert mathematics/progress without claiming a measured active interleaving.

reviews.independent_scope: Apple native finish, internal notification seam, Graph pre-poll epoch/outstanding barrier and four lifecycle tests
checked: Native done is published only after native uses retire; the second monitor section takes late abandoned/hint/notification attachments.
Registration permits inline callbacks outside the Graph monitor; success consumes a reference and failure does not.
Graph waits for notification reference release before terminal publication or reuse; hints do not replace checked native results.
Four native tests use only existing exports plus the new private subscribe_completion export across shared boundaries.
Copy support with no actual G09 caller was removed; both original copy source/test blobs remain unchanged.

root_review: Original and two-stage native retirement windows were checked, including a destroy arriving between native-use retirement and done publication.
Pure CPU execution with a stopped but valid pool was added as a targeted public regression case.
Existing CPU policy and both eligible mature MatMul providers were checked to ensure the public ParallelExecutor gate is actually invoked for the chosen 64x64 shape.
remaining: Ordinary native/device/host/three-delivery verification, fixed-candidate performance qualification and final independent review.
